component.name: VeriLock
component.description: Raspberry Pi Version One release for Raspberry Pi OS Debian 13 Trixie ARM64 and CPython 3.13

properties.name: verilock:scope
properties.value: Demo Pi installed Debian packages and Python distributions visible to the VeriLock virtual environment, plus release OS image, interpreter and model assets.

properties.name: verilock:dependency-resolution
properties.value: Depends and Pre-Depends are resolved against installed packages and versioned virtual package providers. Where more than one installed package satisfies an alternative, the graph lists all matching installed candidates. Python edges use the default environment markers and virtual environment precedence.

properties.name: verilock:submission-status
properties.value: Final release inventory from the demo Pi exports

properties.name: verilock:verified-dependency-scope
properties.value: Every Debian Depends and Pre-Depends clause has an installed candidate. Every applicable default Python requirement in the transitive closure of the 58 project virtual-environment distributions resolves in the export. Seven declarations from system Python type-stub distributions outside that closure remain unresolved.

properties.name: verilock:module-ownership-evidence
properties.value: Demo Pi dpkg-query -S identifies python3-debconf as owner of /usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/debconf.py, resolving the system Python apt-listchanges requirement.

properties.name: verilock:composition-scope
properties.value: The complete dependency composition covers the default Python graph reachable from the 58 project virtual-environment distributions (69 distributions total). The demo Pi inventory composition includes seven unresolved declarations from six system type-stub distributions outside that graph.

properties.name: verilock:version-source
properties.value: 13.7 is the provisioning release baseline. The installed Debian base-files revision is recorded separately in the demo Pi package inventory.

properties.name: verilock:license-scope
properties.value: Distribution-level inventory. Terms are determined per package.

properties.name: verilock:provisioning-image-evidence
properties.value: /etc/rpi-issue, /boot/firmware/issue.txt and /boot/issue.txt all report Raspberry Pi reference 2026-09-15, pi-gen commit 2c235fa703cacb65e0fe0b2ab2fcb23d44dfd268, stage4. Stage4 is the standard desktop image. The SHA-256 identifies the publisher archive.

license.name: Multiple licenses; see individual Raspberry Pi OS packages

externalReferences.comment: Publisher archive and SHA-256 for the September 15, 2026 Raspberry Pi OS Trixie ARM64 desktop provisioning image. All three issue files on the demo Pi report the September 15 build and pi-gen stage4.
